detail.longDescription:
Siri is the personal assistant that helps you get things done, while protecting your privacy. The new version of Siri, Siri AI, is now more conversational, so you can have rich conversations across the system. And for moments when you want to go back to a conversation, you can turn to the new Siri app.

Your conversations, everywhere. Launch the Siri app to see an overview of your past conversations, organized by recency. The app brings conversations together from across your devices — privately synced using iCloud — so you can start on iPhone, continue on iPad, and finish on Mac or Vision Pro. You can search to find past conversations, and pin ones you revisit often so they show at the top of the app.

Find what you need. With personal context understanding, Siri can search across supported apps like Mail, Messages, Photos, Notes, Reminders, Journal, and Calendar to surface what you're looking for. And developers can add support for their apps so that Siri can search across them too.

Get answers. Siri can provide detailed, up-to-date answers on virtually any topic. And because it understands your personal context, it can answer questions like “What’s the closest beach to Tom’s house?"

Get things done. Siri can take action across your apps, like drafting an email, adding photos to a shared album, getting directions with a stop along the way, and importing a set of events to your calendar.

Siri is available across platforms, including iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple Vision Pro, and CarPlay.
